test_beta_binomial_conjugate: run the beta-binomial conjugate prior test using SingleSiteUniformMetropolisHastings inference
test_gamma_gamma_conjugate: run the gamma-gamma conjugate prior test with a fixed random seed of 123
test_gamma_normal_conjugate: run the gamma-normal conjugate prior test with 7500 MCMC samples
test_normal_normal_conjugate: run the normal-normal conjugate prior test with 5000 MCMC samples
test_dirichlet_categorical_conjugate: run the dirichlet-categorical conjugate prior test with 5000 MCMC samples
